PowerShell($env:AWS_PROFILE='algoflow'; $env:AWS_REGION='ap-south-1'; $s = aws secretsmanager get-secret-value --secret-id sahai/production-backend/dev --query SecretString --output text | ConvertFrom-Json; $s.PSObject.Properties | Where-Object { $_.Name -match 'abdm|cm|hip|gateway' } | ForEach-Object { $v = "$\($_.Value\)"; if \($_.Name -match 'secret|token|key' -and $v.Length -gt 8\) { $v = $v.Substring\(0,4\) + '...' + $v.Length + 'chars' }; "$\($_.Name\) = $v" })
